summary.text: Paeonian whom Achilles slew on the banks of Scamander in the rout after Asteropaeus fell — named with Thersilochus, Mydon, and the river-bank company.

story.text: When the Paeonians saw their best man mightily vanquished beneath Achilles' hands, the son of Peleus chased them along the eddying river and laid Mnesus in the dust with Thersilochus, Mydon, Astypylus, Thrasius, Aenius, and Ophelestes.
